long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Uzbekistan, Gulbakhor Burkhanovna Ismailova trained at the Tashkent Medical Institute, graduating with honours before pursuing gynaecology. She spent her working life in Tashkent and retired after a career centred on medicine. That record provides the clearest personal chapter of a profile also shaped by her relationship with her brother, industrialist Alisher Usmanov.

Ismailova was named as a beneficiary of family trusts arranged to share assets among relatives as part of the family's succession planning. She later surrendered her right to future benefits, describing the decision as final and irreversible. The move closed that beneficiary chapter; her independent working life was the medical career she pursued in Tashkent.
